# Combined myeloid, Tumor and T cell panel analysis 

## Read in data 

```{r}
sce_Tcell <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas_full/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")
sce_myeloid <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_07.rds")
sce_tumor <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_TU_07.rds")
```

```{r}
## Panel-specific preprocessing 

# A) T cell panel
# Adjust naming
sce_Tcell$celltype_combined <- gsub("-", "_", sce_Tcell$celltype_combined) 
sce_Tcell$celltype_combined <- gsub("/", "_", sce_Tcell$celltype_combined)

# Adjust tissue area
PID_area_MY <- colData(sce_myeloid) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, tissue_area) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

summary(unique(sce_Tcell$PID) %in% unique(sce_myeloid$PID)) #one PID - no tissue area info - TO DO: Re-do CP pipeline for T cell panel

sce_Tcell$tissue_area <- PID_area_MY$mean_tissue_area[match(sce_Tcell$PID, PID_area_MY$PID)]
```


## Mean general phenotypic densities across panels


```{r}
# T cell panel
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_Tcell) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_Tcell) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_celltype_combined$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_celltype_combined$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

general_dens_Tcell <- PID_celltype_combined

general_dens_Tcell <- general_dens_Tcell %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined_broad",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

colnames(general_dens_Tcell) <- paste0("Tcell_", colnames(general_dens_Tcell))
```


```{r}
sce_tumor$celltype_combined_broad <- ifelse(str_detect(sce_tumor$celltype_combined, "TU"), "tumor", sce_tumor$celltype_combined)
```

```{r}
# Tumor panel
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_tumor) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_celltype_combined$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_celltype_combined$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

general_dens_tumor <- PID_celltype_combined

general_dens_tumor <- general_dens_tumor %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined_broad",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

colnames(general_dens_tumor) <- paste0("TU_", colnames(general_dens_tumor))

```

```{r}
sce_myeloid_old <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

sce_myeloid$celltype_combined_broad <- unfactor(sce_myeloid_old$immune_metacluster[match(sce_myeloid$cell_id, sce_myeloid_old$cell_id)])
sce_myeloid$celltype_combined_broad[is.na(sce_myeloid$celltype_combined_broad)] <- "tumor"
sce_myeloid$celltype_combined_broad <- factor(sce_myeloid$celltype_combined_broad)
```

```{r}
# myeloid panel
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_myeloid) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined_broad,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame

PID_area <- colData(sce_myeloid) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))

PID_celltype_combined$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_celltype_combined$PID, PID_area$PID)]
  
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000))  

general_dens_myeloid <- PID_celltype_combined

general_dens_myeloid <- general_dens_myeloid %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined_broad",values_from = "density") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

colnames(general_dens_myeloid) <- paste0("MY_", colnames(general_dens_myeloid))
```


```{r}
dens_df <- data.frame(PID = c(unique(sce_tumor$PID), unique(sce_Tcell$PID), unique(sce_myeloid$PID)) %>% unique())


for (entry in colnames(general_dens_myeloid)) {
  dens_df[,entry] <- general_dens_myeloid[,entry][match(dens_df$PID,rownames(general_dens_myeloid))]
}

for (entry in colnames(general_dens_tumor)) {
  dens_df[,entry] <- general_dens_tumor[,entry][match(dens_df$PID,rownames(general_dens_tumor))]
}

for (entry in colnames(general_dens_Tcell)) {
  dens_df[,entry] <- general_dens_Tcell[,entry][match(dens_df$PID,rownames(general_dens_Tcell))]
}
```

```{r}
stromal_cols <- colnames(dens_df)[str_detect(colnames(dens_df), "Stromal")]
stromal_df <- dens_df %>% select(PID, all_of(stromal_cols))
stromal_df$Stromal <- rowMeans(stromal_df[2:ncol(stromal_df)], na.rm = TRUE)

endothelial_cols <- colnames(dens_df)[str_detect(colnames(dens_df), "Endothelial")]
endothelial_df <- dens_df %>% select(PID, all_of(endothelial_cols))
endothelial_df$Endothelial <- rowMeans(endothelial_df[2:ncol(endothelial_df)], na.rm = TRUE)


stromal_endo_df <- stromal_df %>% select(PID, Stromal)
stromal_endo_df$Endothelial <- endothelial_df$Endothelial[match(stromal_endo_df$PID, stromal_df$PID)]

stromal_endo_df <- stromal_endo_df %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

stromal_endo_df_scaled <- as.data.frame(scale(stromal_endo_df))

Heatmap(stromal_endo_df_scaled)
```
```{r}
library(clValid)
#Internal measures
set.seed(22)
testCL<- clValid(stromal_endo_df_scaled,nClust = 2:10,clMethods = c("kmeans"),validation="internal",metric="euclidean", method = "ward")
summary(testCL)
plot(testCL, legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
set.seed(22)
h_select <- Heatmap(stromal_endo_df_scaled, 
        row_km = 5, #or3
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        row_km_repeats = 5000)

h_select <- draw(h_select)

## Selection 
row_order_h_ag <- row_order(h_select)

anno <- stromal_endo_df_scaled %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% select(PID)
anno$PID_group <- NA

library(foreach)
foreach(i = seq_along(row_order_h_ag))%do%{
anno$PID_group <- as.factor((ifelse(rownames(anno) %in% row_order_h_ag[[i]], i, anno$PID_group)))
}

anno$status_OS <- sce_Tcell$status_OS[match(anno$PID, sce_Tcell$PID)]
anno$OS_months <- sce_Tcell$OS_months[match(anno$PID, sce_Tcell$PID)]
```

```{r}
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ PID_group, data = anno)

ggsurvplot(fit, 
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, # Add risk table
          risk.table.col = "strata", # Change risk table color by groups
          linetype = "strata", # Change line type by groups
          surv.median.line = "hv", # Specify median survival
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), # Change ggplot2 theme
          #palette = c("#0571B0", "black", "#CA0020","#0571B0","grey"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```
